The immutable Hub package is the public Hub SDK and CLI packed (`npm pack`) from AgentOrg `0fa00d88ce698751433a76ae68add1efd54f258b`, tree `8aa7e6dde7a409312d8f8d366d79b87f1017eeb8`: the flat organization after `@agentorg/cli` 0.0.1 ([AgentOrg PRs 77](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/77), [78](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/78), [79](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/79) and [80](https://github.com/uniac-ai/AgentOrg/pull/80)), with the flat Workspace at `95ebd39`. Its version string is still 0.0.1, so it is told apart from the release by its hash. The authoritative Tool descriptions are used without a local override.

`agentorg-cli-0fa00d8.tgz` has SHA256 `f3d9ac93c3d1d7765b4b865501a748c0dd16f94e9048b22848ac1aa0f883bb0a`. Production imports only its public `@agentorg/cli/contract` schemas/types. Tests additionally launch its public `agentorg-server` command against an owned temporary home and use exported Actor APIs. No sibling checkout or private server/storage imports are used.

The Hub bundles `@uniac/agentic-workspace`, MIT-licensed, at `95ebd39`: every Actor on one flat level; asks on Work, routed to the Work's requester, or to the person when the asker requested it itself, answered with `work_answer`; approvals answered only by the Actor they route to; submissions answered by their requester; and Messages in their pair's conversation. The full Hub catalog has 8 Tools and 21 interfaces, all offered to every Actor. Test fixtures always use new empty homes.
